You amuse me, hairless one. For now.
Today I do not hunger, ape. Be gone before that changes.

hostile.text: Your pelt will adorn my hall, ape!
Crawl back to your dirtball, human filth!
I will savor the snapping of your bones.
You stink of fear, ape. It excites me.
Run, little human. It makes the kill sweeter.
Your ancestors fled us. You will only die tired.

low_hp.text: The hunt turns! This cannot be!
My ship bleeds! Curse you, ape!

kill.text: Your bones are mine to mount.
Another ape returns to the void. Hrrr.
Hrraaa! A worthy pelt for my wall.

greeting.text: Repent, sinner, the Church of Man watches my quad.
Repent, sinner, the Church of Man watches these lanes.
Repent, sinner, the Church of Man watches this quadrant.
Repent, sinner, the Church of Man watches Confed space.
Repent, sinner, the Church of Man watches the asteroid fields.
Repent, sinner, the Church of Man watches this sector.
Cast off your machines and be saved.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, chum, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, sunshine, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, Ace, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, buddy, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, rookie, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, sweetheart, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, mister, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, pilot, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, big shot, and live.
Turn from your wicked circuitry, stranger, and live.

hostile.text: Die by the very weapons you adore!
Your destruction is the will of God!
Sinner, ready thyself for righteous retribution!
Your engines are blasphemy! I will silence them!
The machine-spirit in you must be purged, heathen!

low_hp.text: The Lord tests me! I shall not yield!
Machines of damnable intent, you wound me!

kill.text: The purifying fire takes another heathen!
The Church of Man condemns you. Burn.
Cleansed. The Church of Man rejoices.

greeting.text: We are the guardians. Your kind is... noted.
Lifeform detected. Intent: unknown.
We have watched your kind crawl from the mud. Curious.

hostile.text: You will surrender the relic, primitive.
Your weapons are dust against us.
Your tools are crude. Your end is certain.
You touch what is not yours, fledgling species.

kill.text: Threat neutralized. We endure.
You were nothing. We remain.
